causal_graphs.context: Qualitative crystal-violet tube assay at37 C under static conditions. The30 C library screen is a separate assay, not a replicate of this endpoint.

evidence.explanation: Original Figure1B and its caption establish the qualitative tube contrast; Table1 names wzy-Tn5. Original1D constrains invasion claims. The insertion was mapped by the authors,not independently sequenced in this review.

edges.mechanism: The named wzy-Tn5 tube has much less ring staining than the parental43895 tube. This whole-cell phenotype does not resolve biomass,attachment,dye retention or polar contributions. Comparable intracellular recovery in Figure1D is not converted into an invasion-defect edge.
edges.subject: wzy-insertion

causal_graphs.family_mapping: The2024follow-up cites CP008957.1; AIG69277.1/EDL933_3111 equals Q8X4T7/BAB36267.1,394 aa,PF01901 8-205,score0.041. ATCC documents ATCC700927 as derived from ATCC43895. Their lineage relationship is established; the experimental stock, insertion junction and affected domain segment are not independently sequenced here.
causal_graphs.limitations: No Wzy-specific rescue or downstream-expression control was established. csgB complementation is not wzy rescue. The later2024study retains residual biofilm under its conditions; do not infer universal absence or direct PF01901 chemistry.

causal_graphs.context: Silver-stained Tricine-SDS-PAGE of whole-cell LPS preparations. Figure1A is an expected-structure schematic,not a purified polymerase experiment or complete chemical structure determination.

evidence.explanation: Visually inspected Figure1B is the observed gel; Figure1A supplies an interpretation,not an independent chemical assay. Table1 identifies reuse of the2020insertion mutant.

edges.mechanism: The mutant lane loses the parental long-O-antigen signal while retaining a lower band assigned to one repeat unit. This supports a strain-scoped LPS assembly contribution without demonstrating purified Wzy chemistry,processivity or a particular glycosidic linkage.

causal_graphs.family_mapping: CP008957.1/AIG69277.1 equals Q8X4T7/BAB36267.1,with PF01901 at8-205 of394 aa,score0.041. ATCC700927 is a documented derivative of ATCC43895,not independently sequenced assay DNA. O85335/AAC32340.1 differs at234 and is not substituted; the historical insertion remains unverified.
causal_graphs.limitations: The actual genotype is Tn5,not a verified clean delta-wzy deletion despite the schematic label. No allele-specific rescue,exact insertion position or neighboring-expression measurement was established. The weak partial family hit does not establish an isolated catalytic domain or archaeal transfer.

causal_graphs.context: Crystal-violet microtiter endpoint at37 C after24h. Methods says MSM with0.04%glucose but the caption says4%; this source discrepancy is unresolved. Caption reports six assays per strain,mean/SD and ANOVA with Dunnett comparison.

evidence.explanation: Original Figure2B and its caption establish the directional comparison and reported statistics. Original2A retains a ring. The glucose,time and plotted-versus-text mean discrepancies remain explicit instead of supplying a false exact protocol or effect size.

edges.mechanism: The wzy-Tn5 bar is below parental43895 with the caption's p<0.01 comparison. Residual signal remains. Altered attachment,biomass,dye retention or envelope effects are not separated; no causal chain from the LPS band to this readout is inferred from their co-occurrence.

causal_graphs.family_mapping: CP008957.1/AIG69277.1 equals Q8X4T7/BAB36267.1,394 aa,PF01901 8-205,score0.041. ATCC700927 is a documented derivative of ATCC43895. Exact experimental-stock sequence and insertion remain unresolved; this is not a verified domain-specific perturbation.
causal_graphs.limitations: Lower staining is not complete biofilm loss; Figure2A retains a weaker ring. Tube duration is overnight in Methods versus48h in caption/Results. Figure3 does not supply a matched wzy growth curve. No Wzy-specific rescue was established; reused2020allele is not an independent genotype replication.

causal_graphs.context: Soft-agar population-spread endpoint. Methods/caption report40h while Results says48h. Caption gives three repeats,mean/SD,two-tailed unpaired t-test and p<0.01 for the wzy contrast.

evidence.explanation: Original Figure4 upper bars and lower immunoblot were inspected together. Figure5 retains wzy Congo-red binding. The40h/48h discrepancy and lack of allele-specific rescue prevent stronger mechanistic attribution.

edges.mechanism: The wzy-Tn5 halo is smaller but nonzero compared with WT. The same figure retains a flagellin band,so neither absence of flagella nor direct inhibition of their biosynthesis follows. Envelope,motility and growth contributions remain unresolved.

causal_graphs.family_mapping: CP008957.1/AIG69277.1 equals Q8X4T7/BAB36267.1,PF01901 8-205 of394 aa,score0.041. ATCC700927 derives from ATCC43895 according to ATCC. The historical assay stock and insertion are not independently verified; no residue-specific archaeal mechanism follows.
causal_graphs.limitations: Residual spread and the flagellin immunoblot band remain. Halo diameter is not motor speed or flagellum abundance. No Wzy-specific rescue or matched wzy growth control was established. Retained Congo-red binding in Figure5 also excludes a complete-curli-loss claim.

record.description: Archaebacterial proteins of unknown function. Members of this family may be transmembrane proteins. These are potentially O-antigen assembly enzymes, with up to 11 transmembrane regions.

evidence.explanation: ATCC establishes the700927-to-43895derivative relationship. Earlier unexplained-lineage wording is refined,not converted into proof of an exact historical assay sequence.
ATCC43888 complementation supports its spot-clearing contrast,not rescue of another strain's allele. Its matched QDZ55367.1 reference improves identity grounding without sequencing the plasmid.

Figures1/2/4 retain long-O-antigen,biomass and halo reductions; residual signal,flagellin and Congo-red binding constrain interpretation. The cited CP008957 reference equals Q8X4T7 but names ATCC700927,not an independently sequenced ATCC43895 culture. Glucose and duration discrepancies remain unresolved.
Figure1B supports reduced tube staining;1D does not show the csgB-like invasion reduction for wzy. csgB rescue must not become wzy rescue. The later study reuses this mutant.

discussions.notes: Seven graphs retain eight indirect observed effects,not purified polymerization or a family-wide assignment. The strain lineage is resolved,but exact alleles,downstream-expression controls and assay-matched controls remain open. ATCC43888 rescue is separate from the unrescued2008/2020/2024contexts. New evidence supplements historical ledgers without overwriting them.
discussions.prompt: Resolve exact experimental wzy alleles and assay reporting before assigning a domain mechanism.
discussions.rationale: Whole-cell insertion effects support the measured directions but do not isolate Wzy chemistry,polar effects or a PF01901 catalytic segment. Current O157 membership is a short score0.041 hit,unlike the strong archaeal matches.

evidence.explanation: Current family metadata remains tentative. Exact sequence comparisons map four references; archaeal PF01901 intervals are11-336 and14-363,whereas O157 is8-205. O85335 and Q8X4T7 differ at234.

FPC840_340035 has a Table3 HHpredPF01901 relationship but no reported InterProScan hit. Comparative genomics and serotype PCR are not gene-perturbation evidence; current sequence mapping remains open.

discussions.notes: Selected2008capsule and2021BECP10evidence is now inspected; their additional contexts and supplements remain bounded. The2004doi10.1074/jbc.M401879200full paper remains inaccessible through attempted endpoints. O86purified Wzy is reportedPF14296,not transferable here. No molybdate edge follows from Q6LY80's submitted name. Keep IN_PROGRESS pending member-specific evidence.
discussions.prompt: Inspect additional O157 primary experiments and archaeal members without transferring other Wzy families.
discussions.rationale: The237 frozen proteins are not covered by these O157 contexts. Reviewed Q57862/MJ0419 and Q57863/MJ0420 are uncharacterized in the inspected annotation; this is not proof of absent experiments. EX_DUF naming and clanCL0499 do not establish universal polymerase chemistry.
